name: DG Switchover 故障排查 — SWITCHOVER_STATUS 异常
description: Data Guard Switchover 失败或长时间挂起，通常表现为 v$database.switchover_status 不是 TO STANDBY 或 TO PRIMARY。本规则提供 SWITCHOVER_STATUS 各异常值的系统排查框架，帮助定位并解决阻塞 switchover 的根因。

root_causes.name: redo gap 未解决
root_causes.desc: 主备之间存在 archive log gap，status 显示 RECOVERY NEEDED 或 NOT ALLOWED。gap 可能由网络中断、备库停机、archive log 被删除引起。

root_causes.name: 备库 MRP 未启动或异常
root_causes.desc: 备库 MRP 未运行或 error 状态，switchover_status 显示 NOT ALLOWED。无活跃 MRP 则无法完成角色转换。

root_causes.name: redo transport 配置错误
root_causes.desc: LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n 配置错误、TNS 解析失败、密码文件不匹配，导致 redo 无法发送到备库。

root_causes.name: 活跃会话阻塞角色转换
root_causes.desc: SESSIONS ACTIVE 状态，存在活跃用户会话或分布式事务阻塞角色转换。

root_causes.name: DG Broker 配置不一致
root_causes.desc: Broker 配置主备不同步，ORA-16817 或 ORA-16810，需要 reinstate 或重新配置。

step1_check_status.desc: 确认当前 switchover_status 和数据库角色
step1_check_status.sql: SELECT database_role, switchover_status, open_mode, protection_mode, protection_level, dataguard_broker FROM v$database

step2_check_gap.desc: 检查是否存在 archive log gap
step2_check_gap.sql: SELECT thread#, low_sequence#, high_sequence# FROM v$archive_gap

step3_check_mrp.desc: 检查 MRP 进程状态
step3_check_mrp.sql: SELECT process, pid, status, thread#, sequence#, block#, blocks FROM v$managed_standby WHERE process IN ('MRP0','MR (fg)','PR00') OR process LIKE 'PR%'

step4_check_transport.desc: 检查 redo transport 状态和错误
step4_check_transport.sql: SELECT dest_id, status, error, type, srl, affirm, valid_role, db_unique_name FROM v$archive_dest WHERE target = 'STANDBY' OR dest_id BETWEEN 2 AND 10

step5_check_active_sessions.desc: 检查可能阻塞切换的活跃会话
step5_check_active_sessions.sql: SELECT sid, serial#, username, status, sql_id, program, last_call_et FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY last_call_et DESC

step6_check_alert_log.desc: 检查 alert log 中 switchover 相关错误
step6_check_alert_log.sql: SELECT originating_timestamp, message_text FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE (message_text LIKE '%switchover%' OR message_text LIKE '%ORA-168%') AND originating_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2' HOUR ORDER BY originating_timestamp DESC

emergency_playbook.scenario: 计划维护窗口 switchover 失败

steps.sql: SELECT database_role, switchover_status, open_mode FROM v$database

steps.action: 检查 alert log 最近错误
steps.sql: SELECT originating_timestamp, message_text FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE originating_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE AND message_text LIKE '%ORA-%' ORDER BY originating_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

steps.action: 如果双备库状态，在原主库执行
steps.sql:
ALTER DATABASE COMMIT TO SWITCHOVER TO PRIMARY WITH SESSION SHUTDOWN;
ALTER DATABASE OPEN;
steps.risk: 双备库状态需谨慎判断原主库

steps.action: 如果无法修复走 failover 降级
steps.sql:
ALTER DATABASE RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE FINISH;
ALTER DATABASE ACTIVATE PHYSICAL STANDBY DATABASE;

version_specific_notes.11gR2: switchover 语法 ALTER DATABASE COMMIT TO SWITCHOVER，无 WITH SESSION SHUTDOWN
version_specific_notes.12c: 引入 ALTER DATABASE SWITCHOVER TO 简化语法，支持 WITH SESSION SHUTDOWN 和 CANCEL
version_specific_notes.19c: Broker switchover 更可靠，自动处理 SESSIONS ACTIVE
version_specific_notes.21c+: PDB 级 switchover 支持更成熟
